source.text: קְֽרָא־נָ֭א הֲיֵ֣שׁ עוֹנֶ֑ךָּ וְאֶל־מִ֖י מִקְּדֹשִׁ֣ים תִּפְנֶֽה׃

records.literal_gloss: Call please; [is] there [one] answering you? And to which of [the] holy [ones] will you turn?

en.L: Call, please; is there [anyone] answering you? \q And to which of [the] holy ones will you turn?
en.B: Call out, then; is there anyone who will answer you? \q To which of the holy ones will you turn?
en.R: Go ahead and call for help, but will anyone answer you? \q Which of the heavenly beings will you turn to?

es.L: Llama, pues; ¿hay [alguien] que te responda? \q ¿Y a cuál de [los] santos te volverás?
es.B: Clama, pues; ¿habrá alguien que te responda? \q ¿A cuál de los seres santos acudirás?
es.R: Anda, pide ayuda, pero ¿alguien te responderá? \q ¿A cuál de los seres celestiales acudirás?

fr.L: Appelle donc ; y a-t-il [quelqu’un] qui te réponde ? \q Et vers lequel des saints te tourneras-tu ?
fr.B: Appelle donc ! Quelqu’un te répondra-t-il ? \q Vers lequel des êtres saints te tourneras-tu ?
fr.R: Vas-y, appelle au secours, mais qui te répondra ? \q Vers lequel des êtres célestes te tourneras-tu ?

sw.L: Ita basi; je, yuko [mtu] anayekujibu? \q Na utamgeukia yupi kati ya watakatifu?
sw.B: Basi, ita kwa sauti; je, yuko mtu atakayekujibu? \q Utamgeukia yupi kati ya walio watakatifu?
sw.R: Haya, omba msaada, lakini je, kuna mtu atakayekujibu? \q Utamgeukia yupi kati ya viumbe wa mbinguni?

vi.L: Hãy kêu đi; có [ai] đáp lời anh chăng? \q Và anh sẽ quay về ai trong các đấng thánh?
vi.B: Cứ kêu lên đi; có ai sẽ trả lời anh không? \q Anh sẽ hướng về đấng thánh nào?
vi.R: Anh cứ kêu cứu đi, nhưng có ai trả lời anh không? \q Anh sẽ cầu đến đấng nào ở trên trời?

ko.L: 어디 불러 보시오. 그대에게 대답할 [이가] 있겠소? \q 거룩한 이들 가운데 누구에게 그대가 향하겠소?
ko.B: 불러 보시오. 그대에게 대답할 이가 있겠소? \q 거룩한 이들 가운데 누구를 찾아가겠소?
ko.R: 도와 달라고 외쳐 보시오. 하지만 누가 대답하겠소? \q 하늘의 존재들 가운데 누구에게 기대겠소?

decisions.choice: the holy ones: heavenly beings, God's attendants
decisions.reason: "Holy ones" is a name for the beings who stand around God in heaven (Job 15:15; Psalm 89:6, 8; Zechariah 14:5). Eliphaz has just said that God finds fault even with his servants and messengers (4:18), so no heavenly being will take Job's side against God.

decisions.choice: a challenge: call, but no one will answer
alternatives: a sincere suggestion to pray to the holy ones
decisions.reason: The word "please" (na') softens the command, but the question that follows expects the answer "no one". Eliphaz is not telling Job to appeal to angels; he is saying that no appeal against God will be heard.

decisions.choice: the heavenly beings
decisions.reason: Readable says "heavenly beings", the same words it uses for "the sons of God" in Job 1:6, because "holy ones" alone could be taken for holy people on earth (m1).

decisions.choice: Eliphaz calls Job "anh" and himself "tôi"
decisions.reason: Job and his three friends are equals of long standing; the book's terms note sets "anh" / "các anh" and "tôi" each way at every level, so the friendship and the sharpness of the debate both come through.

decisions.choice: Eliphaz speaks to Job in 하오체 with "그대" (보시오, 있겠소)
decisions.reason: The friends are older men speaking to an equal they respect; 하오체 with 그대 keeps that dignity at every level, as the book's terms note sets for Job and his friends.

source.text: כִּֽי־לֶֽ֭אֱוִיל יַהֲרָג־כָּ֑עַשׂ וּ֝פֹתֶ֗ה תָּמִ֥ית קִנְאָֽה׃

records.literal_gloss: For [to] a fool kills vexation, and a simple [one] slays jealousy.

en.L: For vexation kills the fool, \q and jealousy slays the simple.
en.B: For resentment kills the fool, \q and envy slays the simple.
en.R: Anger kills a foolish person, \q and jealousy kills someone who is easily led.

es.L: Porque al necio lo mata la irritación, \q y al simple lo hacen morir los celos.
es.B: Porque el resentimiento mata al necio, \q y la envidia acaba con el ingenuo.
es.R: La ira mata al necio, \q y los celos matan al que se deja engañar.

fr.L: Car l’irritation tue l’insensé, \q et la jalousie fait mourir le simple.
fr.B: Car la rancœur tue l’insensé, \q et l’envie fait périr le naïf.
fr.R: La colère tue l’insensé, \q et la jalousie tue celui qui se laisse tromper.

sw.L: Kwa maana hasira humwua mpumbavu, \q na wivu humfisha mjinga.
sw.B: Kwa maana kinyongo humwua mpumbavu, \q na husuda humwangamiza mjinga.
sw.R: Hasira humwua mtu mpumbavu, \q na wivu humwua mtu anayedanganywa kwa urahisi.

vi.L: Vì sự bực tức giết kẻ ngu dại, \q và lòng ghen tị làm chết kẻ khờ dại.
vi.B: Vì nỗi oán hận giết chết kẻ ngu dại, \q và lòng đố kỵ hủy diệt kẻ khờ dại.
vi.R: Cơn giận giết chết người ngu dại, \q và lòng ghen tị giết chết người dễ bị lừa.

ko.L: 참으로 분노는 미련한 자를 죽이고, \q 질투는 어리석은 자를 죽이는 법이오.
ko.B: 원한은 미련한 자를 죽이고, \q 시기는 순진한 사람을 죽이는 법이오.
ko.R: 분노는 미련한 사람을 죽이고, \q 질투는 쉽게 속는 사람을 죽이오.

decisions.choice: the fool is the one who is killed
decisions.reason: The little word "to" (le) here marks the object of the verb, as it often does in later Hebrew and in Aramaic: vexation kills the fool. The second line has the same shape: jealousy kills the simple.

decisions.choice: vexation: brooding, angry grief; jealousy: hot, passionate feeling
decisions.reason: Ka'as is the anger and grief that a person nurses inside (1 Samuel 1:6, 16; Proverbs 27:3). Qin'ah is any burning passion: jealousy, envy, or zeal. Eliphaz is warning Job: his angry complaint (chapter 3) is the kind of thing that destroys fools. Job takes up the same word ka'as in 6:2.

decisions.choice: the simple: a naive person, easily led
decisions.reason: The simple person (poteh) is the inexperienced one who believes anything and is easily misled, as often in Proverbs (Proverbs 1:4, 22; 14:15).

decisions.choice: resentment
decisions.reason: "Vexation" is rare in modern speech. "Resentment" names the brooding anger that the word means (m2).

source.text: אֲֽנִי־רָ֭אִיתִי אֱוִ֣יל מַשְׁרִ֑ישׁ וָאֶקּ֖וֹב נָוֵ֣הוּ פִתְאֹֽם׃

records.literal_gloss: I, I have seen [a] fool taking root, and I cursed his dwelling suddenly.

en.L: I have seen a fool taking root, \q and suddenly I cursed his dwelling.
en.B: I myself have seen a fool putting down roots, \q but suddenly I declared his home cursed.
en.R: I have seen a foolish man doing well, like a plant putting down roots, \q but right away I said his home was cursed.

es.L: Yo he visto al necio echar raíces, \q y de repente maldije su morada.
es.B: Yo mismo he visto a un necio echar raíces, \q pero de pronto declaré maldita su casa.
es.R: He visto a un necio prosperar, como una planta que echa raíces, \q pero enseguida dije que su casa estaba maldita.

fr.L: Moi, j’ai vu l’insensé prendre racine, \q et soudain j’ai maudit sa demeure.
fr.B: J’ai vu moi-même un insensé s’enraciner, \q mais aussitôt j’ai déclaré sa maison maudite.
fr.R: J’ai vu un insensé réussir, comme une plante qui prend racine, \q mais tout de suite j’ai dit que sa maison était maudite.

sw.L: Mimi nimemwona mpumbavu akitia mizizi, \q nami ghafla nikayalaani makao yake.
sw.B: Mimi mwenyewe nimemwona mpumbavu akishika mizizi, \q lakini ghafla nikatangaza kwamba nyumba yake imelaaniwa.
sw.R: Nimemwona mtu mpumbavu akifanikiwa, kama mmea unaotia mizizi, \q lakini mara moja nikasema nyumba yake imelaaniwa.

vi.L: Chính tôi đã thấy kẻ ngu dại đâm rễ, \q và thình lình tôi nguyền rủa nơi ở của hắn.
vi.B: Chính tôi đã thấy một kẻ ngu dại bén rễ vững vàng, \q nhưng thình lình tôi tuyên bố nhà hắn bị nguyền rủa.
vi.R: Tôi đã thấy một người ngu dại làm ăn khấm khá, như cây đâm rễ, \q nhưng ngay lập tức tôi nói nhà người ấy bị nguyền rủa.

ko.L: 내가 미련한 자가 뿌리내리는 것을 보았고, \q 갑자기 그의 거처를 저주하였소.
ko.B: 나 자신도 미련한 자가 뿌리를 내리는 것을 보았으나, \q 곧바로 그의 집이 저주받았다고 선언하였소.
ko.R: 미련한 사람이 식물이 뿌리를 내리듯 잘되는 것을 보았지만, \q 나는 곧 그의 집이 저주받았다고 말했소.

decisions.choice: taking root: settling in and doing well
decisions.reason: A plant that takes root is established and thriving; the picture is used for people who prosper (Psalm 37:35; Jeremiah 12:2). For a time the fool seemed secure.

decisions.choice: I cursed: I declared his home doomed, at once
alternatives: his home was suddenly cursed (a slightly different text)
I cursed it in my heart
decisions.reason: The Hebrew has "I cursed": Eliphaz, seeing the fool prosper, pronounced his home doomed, and the next verses describe what then happened to it. Some ancient translations read "his home was suddenly cursed" (or "rotted"), which needs a small change to the text. "Suddenly" may belong to the curse (at once) or to the ruin that came on the home.

decisions.choice: dwelling: home, homestead
decisions.reason: Naveh can be a pasture or a dwelling place; here, as in 5:24 and 18:15, it is a person's home and all that goes with it.

decisions.choice: doing well, like a plant putting down roots
decisions.reason: Readable explains the picture (m1) so that a young reader does not take it literally.

source.text: יִרְחֲק֣וּ בָנָ֣יו מִיֶּ֑שַׁע וְיִֽדַּכְּא֥וּ בַ֝שַּׁ֗עַר וְאֵ֣ין מַצִּֽיל׃

records.literal_gloss: Far are his sons from safety, and they are crushed in [the] gate, and there is no deliverer.

en.L: His sons are far from safety, \q and they are crushed in the gate, \q and there is no one delivering [them].
en.B: His children are far from safety; \q they are crushed in the court at the gate, \q with no one to rescue them.
en.R: His children are never safe. \q They are crushed in court, and no one is there to rescue them.

es.L: Sus hijos están lejos de la salvación, \q y son aplastados en la puerta, \q y no hay quien [los] libre.
es.B: Sus hijos están lejos de toda seguridad; \q los aplastan en el tribunal de la puerta, \q y no hay nadie que los rescate.
es.R: Sus hijos nunca están a salvo. \q Los aplastan en el tribunal, y nadie está allí para rescatarlos.

fr.L: Ses fils sont loin du salut, \q et ils sont écrasés à la porte, \q et il n’y a personne qui [les] délivre.
fr.B: Ses enfants sont loin de toute sécurité ; \q on les écrase au tribunal, à la porte de la ville, \q sans personne pour les sauver.
fr.R: Ses enfants ne sont jamais en sécurité. \q On les écrase au tribunal, et personne n’est là pour les sauver.

sw.L: Wanawe wako mbali na usalama, \q nao wanapondwa langoni, \q wala hakuna anayewaokoa.
sw.B: Watoto wake wako mbali na usalama; \q wanapondwa mahakamani langoni mwa mji, \q bila mtu wa kuwaokoa.
sw.R: Watoto wake hawako salama kamwe. \q Wanaonewa mahakamani, wala hakuna mtu wa kuwaokoa.

vi.L: Các con trai hắn xa cách sự an toàn, \q chúng bị chà đạp nơi cổng thành, \q và không có ai giải cứu [chúng].
vi.B: Con cái hắn chẳng được an toàn; \q chúng bị chà đạp nơi tòa xét xử tại cổng thành, \q chẳng có ai giải cứu.
vi.R: Con cái hắn không bao giờ được yên ổn. \q Chúng bị đè bẹp nơi tòa án, và không có ai cứu giúp.

ko.L: 그의 아들들은 안전에서 멀고, \q 성문에서 짓밟히나, \q 건져 줄 이가 없소.
ko.B: 그의 자식들은 안전과는 거리가 멀어, \q 성문 재판 자리에서 짓밟혀도 \q 구해 줄 사람이 없소.
ko.R: 그의 자녀들은 결코 안전하지 못하오. \q 재판에서 짓밟혀도 구해 줄 사람이 아무도 없소.

decisions.choice: the gate: the place where cases were judged
alternatives: the city gate as a place of battle
decisions.reason: The elders of a town sat in the gate to hear disputes and give judgment (Deuteronomy 21:19; Ruth 4:1-11; Amos 5:12, 15). To be crushed in the gate is to lose one's case and be wronged by the court, with no one to speak up for you.

decisions.choice: his sons: his children, his family after him
decisions.reason: The word (banim) is "sons", but the point is the fool's whole family line: his household does not escape the ruin.

decisions.choice: safety: help, deliverance
decisions.reason: Yesha' is rescue and the safety it brings; the same word ends 5:11.

decisions.choice: the court at the gate
decisions.reason: Balanced adds "court" so that the reader sees why being crushed in the gate matters (m1).

source.text: אֲשֶׁ֤ר קְצִיר֨וֹ׀רָ֘עֵ֤ב יֹאכֵ֗ל וְאֶֽל־מִצִּנִּ֥ים יִקָּחֵ֑הוּ וְשָׁאַ֖ף צַמִּ֣ים חֵילָֽם׃

records.literal_gloss: Whose harvest [the] hungry eats, and even from thorns he takes it, and a snare pants [for] their wealth.

en.L: Whose harvest [the] hungry eats, \q and even from among thorns he takes it, \q and a snare gapes for their wealth.
en.B: The hungry eat up his harvest, \q taking it even from among the thorns, \q and a trap lies open for their wealth.
en.R: Hungry people eat his harvest; \q they take it even from among the thorns. \q Their wealth is snapped up as if in a trap.

es.L: cuya cosecha come [el] hambriento, \q y aun de entre los espinos la toma, \q y una trampa acecha ansiosa sus riquezas.
es.B: El hambriento devora su cosecha, \q y la arrebata aun de entre los espinos, \q y una trampa se abre para tragarse sus riquezas.
es.R: Los hambrientos se comen su cosecha; \q se la llevan aun de entre los espinos. \q Sus riquezas desaparecen, como atrapadas en una trampa.

fr.L: lui dont [l’]affamé mange la moisson, \q et même d’entre les épines il la prend, \q et un piège s’ouvre, avide, sur leurs richesses.
fr.B: L’affamé dévore sa moisson, \q il va la prendre jusque parmi les épines, \q et un piège attend, grand ouvert, leurs richesses.
fr.R: Des gens affamés mangent sa récolte ; \q ils la prennent même au milieu des épines. \q Leurs richesses disparaissent, comme prises dans un piège.

sw.L: ambaye mavuno yake [mtu] mwenye njaa huyala, \q hata kutoka katikati ya miiba huyachukua, \q na mtego hutamani mali yao.
sw.B: Wenye njaa hula mavuno yake, \q huyachukua hata katikati ya miiba, \q na mtego uko wazi kuinasa mali yao.
sw.R: Watu wenye njaa hula mavuno yake; \q huyachukua hata kutoka katikati ya miiba. \q Mali yao hunyakuliwa kana kwamba imenaswa mtegoni.

vi.L: Mùa màng của hắn, kẻ đói ăn mất, \q ngay cả giữa bụi gai nó cũng lấy đi, \q và cạm bẫy há miệng chờ của cải chúng.
vi.B: Kẻ đói ăn sạch mùa màng của hắn, \q lấy cả những gì mọc giữa bụi gai, \q và cạm bẫy giương sẵn chờ của cải của họ.
vi.R: Người đói ăn hết hoa màu của hắn; \q họ lấy cả những gì mọc giữa bụi gai. \q Của cải của nhà hắn bị cướp mất như sa vào bẫy.

ko.L: 그의 수확을 굶주린 자가 먹고, \q 가시덤불 속에서까지 그것을 가져가며, \q 올무가 그들의 재산을 노려 입을 벌리오.
ko.B: 굶주린 자가 그의 수확을 먹어 치우고 \q 가시덤불 속에서까지 거두어 가며, \q 덫이 그들의 재산을 삼키려고 벌어져 있소.
ko.R: 굶주린 사람들이 그의 수확을 먹어 버리고, \q 가시덤불 속에 있는 것까지 가져가오. \q 그들의 재산은 덫에 걸린 듯 빼앗기오.

decisions.choice: a snare: a trap waiting for their wealth
alternatives: the thirsty pant for their wealth
decisions.reason: The vowels of the Hebrew text give tsammim, a snare or trap (Job 18:9). With other vowels the same letters read "the thirsty", which makes a pair with "the hungry" in the first line, and several ancient translations read it so. Either way the fool's family loses what it owns.

decisions.choice: even from among thorns: nothing stops the hungry
decisions.reason: The words "and to, from thorns" are hard. The most likely sense is that the hungry take the crop even where it grows among thorns, or behind the thorn hedge that protected a field. The point is clear: nothing he has is safe.

decisions.choice: their wealth: the fool's household's
decisions.reason: The verse moves from "his" harvest to "their" wealth: the fool and his children (5:4) lose everything together.

decisions.choice: Their wealth is snapped up as if in a trap
alternatives: a snare gapes for their wealth
decisions.reason: Readable puts the wealth first and makes the trap a comparison, which is easier to follow than a trap that gapes.

source.text: כִּ֤י׀לֹא־יֵצֵ֣א מֵעָפָ֣ר אָ֑וֶן וּ֝מֵאֲדָמָ֗ה לֹא־יִצְמַ֥ח עָמָֽל׃

records.literal_gloss: For not goes out from the dust trouble, and from the ground not sprouts toil.

en.L: For trouble does not come out of the dust, \q and toil does not sprout from the ground.
en.B: Hardship does not spring up from the dust, \q and trouble does not sprout from the soil.
en.R: Trouble does not grow up out of the dust, \q and hardship does not sprout from the ground.

es.L: Porque la desgracia no sale del polvo, \q ni la fatiga brota del suelo.
es.B: La adversidad no surge del polvo, \q ni la desgracia brota de la tierra.
es.R: Los problemas no crecen del polvo, \q ni el sufrimiento brota de la tierra.

fr.L: Car le malheur ne sort pas de la poussière, \q et la peine ne germe pas du sol.
fr.B: Le malheur ne surgit pas de la poussière, \q et la souffrance ne pousse pas de la terre.
fr.R: Le malheur ne pousse pas dans la poussière, \q et la souffrance ne sort pas de terre.

sw.L: Kwa maana taabu haitoki mavumbini, \q wala mashaka hayachipuki ardhini.
sw.B: Dhiki haiinuki kutoka mavumbini, \q wala taabu haiotei ardhini.
sw.R: Matatizo hayaoti kutoka mavumbini, \q wala mateso hayachipuki ardhini.

vi.L: Vì tai họa chẳng từ bụi đất mà ra, \q và khổ nhọc chẳng từ mặt đất mọc lên.
vi.B: Gian truân không tự bụi đất nảy sinh, \q khốn khó không tự đất đai mọc lên.
vi.R: Rắc rối không tự mọc lên từ bụi đất, \q đau khổ không tự nhú lên từ mặt đất.

ko.L: 재앙은 티끌에서 나오는 것이 아니요, \q 고난은 땅에서 돋아나는 것이 아니오.
ko.B: 고난은 흙에서 솟아나지 않고, \q 괴로움은 땅에서 움트지 않소.
ko.R: 고생은 흙에서 저절로 자라나지 않고, \q 괴로움은 땅에서 돋아나지 않소.

decisions.choice: trouble and toil: harm, with a hint of wrongdoing
decisions.reason: 'Aven can mean trouble or the wickedness that causes it; 'amal is hard toil and the misery it brings. Eliphaz has already said that those who plow 'aven reap 'amal (4:8). Trouble is not a weed that comes up by itself.

decisions.choice: for: this explains verses 2-5
decisions.reason: The verse gives the reason behind the fool's ruin: trouble has a cause. Verse 7 then says where it comes from.

decisions.choice: no "for" at the start
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable leave the linking word unexpressed; the order of the lines already shows the connection. Literal keeps it.

source.text: כִּֽי־אָ֭דָם לְעָמָ֣ל יוּלָּ֑ד וּבְנֵי־רֶ֝֗שֶׁף יַגְבִּ֥יהוּ עֽוּף׃

records.literal_gloss: For man to trouble is born, and [the] sons of flame make high to fly.

en.L: But {{gender:a human|man}} is born to trouble, \q and sons of flame fly high.
en.B: No, {{gender:human beings are|man is}} born to trouble, \q as sparks fly upward.
en.R: {{gender:People are|Man is}} born to have trouble, \q just as sparks always fly up from a fire.

es.L: Sino que {{gender:el ser humano|el hombre}} nace para la aflicción, \q y los hijos de la llama vuelan alto.
es.B: No, {{gender:el ser humano|el hombre}} nace para la aflicción, \q como las chispas vuelan hacia lo alto.
es.R: {{gender:Las personas nacen|El hombre nace}} para tener problemas, \q como las chispas siempre saltan del fuego hacia arriba.

fr.L: Mais {{gender:l’être humain|l’homme}} naît pour la peine, \q et les fils de la flamme volent haut.
fr.B: Non, {{gender:l’être humain|l’homme}} naît pour la peine, \q comme les étincelles s’envolent vers le haut.
fr.R: {{gender:Les humains naissent|L’homme naît}} pour connaître la peine, \q comme les étincelles s’envolent toujours d’un feu.

sw.L: Bali mwanadamu huzaliwa kwa ajili ya taabu, \q na wana wa mwali huruka juu.
sw.B: La, mwanadamu huzaliwa apate taabu, \q kama cheche za moto zirukavyo juu.
sw.R: Watu huzaliwa wapate matatizo, \q kama vile cheche hupanda juu kutoka motoni kila mara.

vi.L: Nhưng loài người sinh ra cho khổ nhọc, \q và con cái của ngọn lửa bay vút lên cao.
vi.B: Không, con người sinh ra để chịu gian truân, \q như tàn lửa bay vút lên cao.
vi.R: Con người sinh ra là phải gặp khổ đau, \q như tàn lửa luôn bay lên từ đống lửa.

ko.L: 오히려 사람은 고난을 위해 태어나고, \q 불꽃의 아들들은 높이 날아오르오.
ko.B: 아니오, 사람은 고난을 겪도록 태어나니, \q 불티가 위로 날아오르는 것과 같소.
ko.R: 사람은 고생하도록 태어났소. \q 불티가 언제나 불에서 위로 튀어 오르듯 말이오.

decisions.choice: but rather: after a negative, it gives the true cause
decisions.reason: After "trouble does not come out of the dust" (verse 6), ki means "no, but": trouble comes from human beings themselves, not from the ground.

decisions.choice: is born to trouble
decisions.reason: The vowels of the Hebrew text read "is born". With other vowels the same letters read "begets": human beings breed their own trouble, which would follow verse 6 even more closely. The written vowels are kept; both say that trouble is part of human life.

decisions.choice: sons of flame: sparks
decisions.reason: "Sons of" names what belongs to a thing, so the sons of a flame (reshef) are sparks. Reshef can also mean a burning bolt or pestilence (Deuteronomy 32:24; Habakkuk 3:5), and some take the line as birds of prey soaring. Sparks fit best: they rise from a fire as surely as trouble comes to people.

decisions.choice: man: any human being
decisions.reason: 'Adam is humankind, every person, not a male only.

decisions.choice: as sparks fly upward
decisions.reason: The Hebrew sets the two lines side by side with "and"; Balanced and Readable make the comparison plain with "as".

decisions.choice: "mwanadamu", "watu" with no gender span
decisions.reason: Swahili "mwanadamu" already means any human being; the only other wording, "mwanamume", means a male and would change the sense, so the English gender setting has nothing to change here.

source.text: אוּלָ֗ם אֲ֭נִי אֶדְרֹ֣שׁ אֶל־אֵ֑ל וְאֶל־אֱ֝לֹהִ֗ים אָשִׂ֥ים דִּבְרָתִֽי׃

records.literal_gloss: But I, I would seek to God, and to God I would set my cause,

en.L: But as for me, I would seek God, \q and to God I would commit my cause,
en.B: But as for me, I would turn to God \q and lay my case before God.
en.R: If I were you, I would turn to God \q and bring my case to {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}.

es.L: Pero yo, yo buscaría a Dios, \q y a Dios encomendaría mi causa,
es.B: Pero yo me volvería a Dios \q y pondría mi causa delante de Dios.
es.R: Si yo fuera tú, me volvería a Dios \q y {{deity_pronoun:le|Le}} presentaría mi caso.

fr.L: Mais moi, je rechercherais Dieu, \q et à Dieu je confierais ma cause,
fr.B: Mais moi, je me tournerais vers Dieu \q et je remettrais ma cause à Dieu.
fr.R: Si j’étais toi, je me tournerais vers Dieu \q et je {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}} présenterais ma cause.

sw.L: Lakini mimi, ningemtafuta Mungu, \q na kwa Mungu ningeliweka shauri langu,
sw.B: Lakini mimi ningemgeukia Mungu \q na kuliweka shauri langu mbele za Mungu.
sw.R: Kama ningekuwa wewe, ningemgeukia Mungu \q na kupeleka shauri langu {{deity_pronoun:kwake|Kwake}}.

vi.L: Nhưng phần tôi, tôi sẽ tìm kiếm Đức Chúa Trời, \q và giao phó duyên cớ mình cho Đức Chúa Trời,
vi.B: Còn tôi, tôi sẽ tìm đến Đức Chúa Trời \q và trình bày vụ việc mình trước Đức Chúa Trời.
vi.R: Nếu tôi là anh, tôi sẽ tìm đến Đức Chúa Trời \q và trình bày nỗi oan của mình với {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}.

ko.L: 그러나 나라면 하나님을 찾고 \q 하나님께 내 사정을 맡기겠소.
ko.B: 그러나 나라면 하나님께 나아가 \q 내 사정을 하나님 앞에 아뢰겠소.
ko.R: 내가 그대라면 하나님께 나아가 \q 그분께 내 사정을 말씀드리겠소.

decisions.choice: I would: advice, what Eliphaz would do in Job's place
alternatives: I will seek God (a statement of Eliphaz's own plan)
decisions.reason: The verb form can mean "I will" or "I would". The emphatic "but I" sets Eliphaz against the fool and against Job's complaint: if he were in Job's place, he would bring his case to God.

decisions.choice: God, God: two words for the one God
decisions.reason: The first line has 'El and the second 'Elohim; Hebrew poetry often varies the word in parallel lines. Both mean God.

decisions.choice: my cause: my case, my complaint
decisions.reason: Dibrah is a matter or cause, here a case laid before a judge. Eliphaz uses the language of the law court, which Job will take up (9:3; 13:3, 18).

decisions.choice: If I were you
decisions.reason: Readable makes the advice plain (m1).

decisions.choice: the verse ends with a full stop
alternatives: a comma, running on into verse 9
decisions.reason: Verse 9 describes God with a participle, "who does great things", so in Hebrew the sentence runs on. Literal keeps the comma; Balanced and Readable start a new sentence with "He" in verse 9.

decisions.choice: Literal ends the verse with a full stop (맡기겠소.)
alternatives: running into verse 9 with a relative clause
decisions.reason: Korean puts a relative clause before its noun, so "God, who does great things" cannot follow across the verse marker; verse 8 closes as its own sentence and verse 9 describes God in a sentence of its own.

source.text: עֹשֶׂ֣ה גְ֭דֹלוֹת וְאֵ֣ין חֵ֑קֶר נִ֝פְלָא֗וֹת עַד־אֵ֥ין מִסְפָּֽר׃

records.literal_gloss: [who] does great [things] and [there is] no searching, wonders until [there is] no number.

en.L: who does great things, and [there is] no searching [them out], \q wonders until [there is] no number.
en.B: He does great things beyond understanding, \q wonders that cannot be counted.
en.R: He does great things that no one can understand, \q more wonderful things than anyone can count.

es.L: que hace cosas grandes, y [no hay] escudriñarlas, \q maravillas hasta [no haber] número.
es.B: Él hace cosas grandes e insondables, \q maravillas que no se pueden contar.
es.R: Hace cosas grandes que nadie puede entender, \q cosas maravillosas, más de las que nadie puede contar.

fr.L: qui fait de grandes choses, et [il n’y a] pas [moyen de les] sonder, \q des merveilles jusqu’à [n’avoir] pas de nombre.
fr.B: Il fait de grandes choses, insondables, \q des merveilles qu’on ne peut compter.
fr.R: Il fait de grandes choses que personne ne peut comprendre, \q des merveilles plus nombreuses qu’on ne peut compter.

sw.L: afanyaye mambo makuu, wala [hakuna] kuyachunguza, \q maajabu hata [hakuna] hesabu.
sw.B: Hufanya mambo makuu yasiyochunguzika, \q maajabu yasiyoweza kuhesabika.
sw.R: Hufanya mambo makuu ambayo hakuna mtu awezaye kuyaelewa, \q maajabu mengi kuliko mtu yeyote awezavyo kuhesabu.

vi.L: Đấng làm những việc lớn lao, [không thể] dò thấu, \q những việc diệu kỳ đến [không thể] đếm được.
vi.B: Ngài làm những việc lớn lao không thể dò thấu, \q những việc diệu kỳ không sao đếm xuể.
vi.R: Ngài làm những việc lớn lao không ai hiểu nổi, \q những việc kỳ diệu nhiều hơn mọi người có thể đếm.

ko.L: 큰일들을 행하시되 측량할 수 없고, \q 기이한 일들을 행하시되 셀 수 없소.
ko.B: 그분은 헤아릴 수 없는 큰일을 하시고 \q 셀 수 없이 많은 기이한 일을 하시는 분이오.
ko.R: 그분은 아무도 이해할 수 없는 큰일을 하시고, \q 누구도 다 셀 수 없을 만큼 놀라운 일을 하시는 분이오.

decisions.choice: who does: the first of a row of descriptions of God
decisions.reason: Verses 9-16 are a short hymn: a string of participles ("who does", "who gives", "who frustrates") describing God. Job repeats this line almost word for word in 9:10, but to say that God's power is frightening.

decisions.choice: no searching: beyond finding out
decisions.reason: "There is no searching" means that no one can search them out or fathom them (Psalm 145:3; Isaiah 40:28).

decisions.choice: He does
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable begin a new sentence and supply "He" for the participle (see 5:8).

source.text: הַנֹּתֵ֣ן מָ֭טָר עַל־פְּנֵי־אָ֑רֶץ וְשֹׁ֥לֵֽחַ מַ֝יִם עַל־פְּנֵ֥י חוּצֽוֹת׃

records.literal_gloss: the [one who] gives rain on [the] face of [the] earth, and sends water on [the] face of [the] open places,

en.L: who gives rain on [the] face of [the] earth \q and sends water on [the] face of [the] fields,
en.B: He gives rain to the earth \q and sends water on the fields.
en.R: He sends rain on the earth \q and waters the fields.

es.L: que da la lluvia sobre [la] faz de la tierra \q y envía agua sobre [la] faz de los campos,
es.B: Él da la lluvia a la tierra \q y envía agua sobre los campos.
es.R: Manda la lluvia sobre la tierra \q y riega los campos.

fr.L: qui donne la pluie sur [la] face de la terre \q et envoie l’eau sur [la] face des campagnes,
fr.B: Il donne la pluie à la terre \q et envoie l’eau sur les champs.
fr.R: Il fait tomber la pluie sur la terre \q et arrose les champs.

sw.L: atoaye mvua juu ya uso wa nchi \q na kupeleka maji juu ya uso wa mashamba,
sw.B: Huipa nchi mvua \q na kupeleka maji mashambani.
sw.R: Huleta mvua juu ya nchi \q na kunywesha mashamba.

vi.L: Đấng ban mưa xuống trên mặt đất \q và sai nước đến trên mặt đồng ruộng,
vi.B: Ngài ban mưa xuống đất \q và sai nước đến trên đồng ruộng.
vi.R: Ngài cho mưa rơi xuống đất \q và tưới nước cho ruộng đồng.

ko.L: 그분은 땅의 표면에 비를 내리시고 \q 들판의 표면에 물을 보내시오.
ko.B: 그분은 땅에 비를 내리시고 \q 들에 물을 보내시오.
ko.R: 그분은 땅에 비를 내리시고 \q 들판을 적시는 분이오.

decisions.choice: the open places: the fields and open country
decisions.reason: Chutsot is what lies outside: in a town the streets, in the country the fields beyond the town. Here it stands beside "the earth", so it means the open land.

decisions.choice: rain as God's gift
decisions.reason: Rain is the gift by which God keeps the land alive (Deuteronomy 11:14; Jeremiah 5:24). When God answers Job, he asks who gives the rain (38:25-28).

decisions.choice: to the earth, on the fields
alternatives: on the face of the earth
decisions.reason: "The face of" is the Hebrew way of saying "the surface of"; Balanced and Readable leave it out. Literal keeps it.

decisions.choice: Eliphaz's hymn about God (5:9-16) keeps 하오체 with the honorific -시- (내리시고, 보내시오; 하시는 분이오)
decisions.reason: The hymn is still Eliphaz speaking to Job, so it stays in the 하오체 he uses to his friend, with -시- for God. Where a bare -시오 could be misread as a command, the line ends with -시는 분이오 instead.

source.text: לָשׂ֣וּם שְׁפָלִ֣ים לְמָר֑וֹם וְ֝קֹדְרִ֗ים שָׂ֣גְבוּ יֶֽשַׁע׃

records.literal_gloss: to set [the] lowly on high, and mourners are high [in] safety.

en.L: to set [the] lowly on high, \q and [those] mourning are lifted to safety.
en.B: He sets the lowly on high, \q and those who mourn are lifted to safety.
en.R: He raises up people who are humble, \q and {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} lifts those who are sad to a safe place.

es.L: para poner en alto a [los] humildes, \q y [los que] están de luto son elevados a la salvación.
es.B: Él pone en alto a los humildes, \q y los que lloran son levantados a un lugar seguro.
es.R: Levanta a los humildes, \q y {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} pone a salvo a los que están tristes.

fr.L: pour placer [les] humbles en haut, \q et [ceux qui sont] en deuil sont élevés jusqu’au salut.
fr.B: Il place en haut les humbles, \q et ceux qui sont en deuil sont élevés en sûreté.
fr.R: Il relève les gens humbles, \q et {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} met à l’abri ceux qui sont tristes.

sw.L: ili kuwaweka juu walio wanyonge, \q na [wale] wanaoomboleza wameinuliwa hadi usalama.
sw.B: Huwaweka juu walio wanyonge, \q na wanaoomboleza huinuliwa mahali salama.
sw.R: Huwainua watu wanyenyekevu, \q {{deity_pronoun:naye|Naye}} huwapeleka mahali salama walio na huzuni.

vi.L: để đặt [những người] thấp hèn lên nơi cao, \q và [những người] than khóc được nâng lên nơi an toàn.
vi.B: Ngài đặt người thấp hèn lên nơi cao, \q và người than khóc được nâng lên chốn an toàn.
vi.R: Ngài nâng đỡ những người khiêm nhường, \q và {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đem những người buồn rầu đến nơi an toàn.

ko.L: 낮은 자들을 높은 곳에 두시니, \q 애곡하는 자들이 높이 들려 안전하게 되오.
ko.B: 그분은 낮은 사람들을 높이 세우시고, \q 슬퍼하는 사람들을 들어 올려 안전하게 하시오.
ko.R: 그분은 겸손한 사람들을 높여 주시고, \q 슬퍼하는 사람들을 안전한 곳으로 들어 올리시는 분이오.

decisions.choice: to set: another thing God does, or the purpose of the rain
decisions.reason: The verb is an infinitive, "to set". It continues the list of God's acts; some take it as the purpose of the rain in verse 10 (he sends rain so as to raise the lowly). The meaning is much the same.

decisions.choice: mourners: those dressed in dark clothes of grief
decisions.reason: Qoderim are literally "the dark ones": people in mourning, unwashed and in dark clothing (Psalm 35:14; 38:7). The same word describes dark streams in 6:16.

decisions.choice: God lifts the lowly
decisions.reason: The same hope is sung in 1 Samuel 2:7-8 and Psalm 113:7-8: God brings down the proud and raises the poor.

decisions.choice: He sets
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable make the infinitive a plain sentence (m1).

source.text: מֵ֭פֵר מַחְשְׁב֣וֹת עֲרוּמִ֑ים וְֽלֹא־תַעֲשֶׂ֥ינָה יְ֝דֵיהֶ֗ם תּוּשִׁיָּֽה׃

records.literal_gloss: [who] frustrates [the] plans of [the] crafty, and their hands do not achieve success.

en.L: [He] frustrates [the] plans of [the] crafty, \q and their hands do not achieve success.
en.B: He thwarts the schemes of the crafty, \q so that their hands achieve nothing.
en.R: He spoils the plans of tricky people, \q so they cannot carry them out.

es.L: [Él] frustra [los] planes de [los] astutos, \q y sus manos no logran éxito.
es.B: Desbarata las intrigas de los astutos, \q y sus manos no consiguen nada.
es.R: Echa a perder los planes de los tramposos, \q y no los pueden llevar a cabo.

fr.L: [Il] déjoue [les] projets des rusés, \q et leurs mains n’obtiennent pas de succès.
fr.B: Il fait échouer les intrigues des rusés, \q si bien que leurs mains n’aboutissent à rien.
fr.R: Il gâche les plans des gens rusés, \q et ils ne peuvent pas les réaliser.

sw.L: [Yeye] huvunja mipango ya wenye hila, \q na mikono yao haipati mafanikio.
sw.B: Huzipinga hila za wajanja, \q hata mikono yao haitimizi chochote.
sw.R: Huiharibu mipango ya watu wadanganyifu, \q nao hawawezi kuitekeleza.

vi.L: [Ngài] phá hỏng mưu kế của kẻ xảo quyệt, \q và tay chúng không đạt được thành công.
vi.B: Ngài làm thất bại mưu đồ của kẻ gian xảo, \q khiến tay chúng chẳng làm nên trò trống gì.
vi.R: Ngài phá hỏng kế hoạch của những kẻ gian manh, \q nên chúng không thể làm được.

ko.L: [그분은] 교활한 자들의 계획을 좌절시키시니, \q 그들의 손이 성공을 이루지 못하오.
ko.B: 그분은 교활한 자들의 계략을 꺾으셔서 \q 그들의 손이 아무것도 이루지 못하게 하시오.
ko.R: 그분은 꾀 많은 사람들의 계획을 망쳐 놓으셔서 \q 그들이 그것을 해내지 못하게 하시는 분이오.

decisions.choice: crafty: cunning, scheming
decisions.reason: 'Arum can be good (prudent, Proverbs 12:16, 23) or bad (cunning, as the serpent in Genesis 3:1). Here it is the bad sense: people whose clever plans work against others.

decisions.choice: success: effective wisdom, a plan that works
decisions.reason: Tushiyyah is a wisdom word for what really works, practical success (Job 6:13; Proverbs 2:7; 3:21). The schemer's hands never get that far.

decisions.choice: achieve nothing
decisions.reason: Balanced says the result plainly; Literal keeps "success".

source.text: לֹכֵ֣ד חֲכָמִ֣ים בְּעָרְמָ֑ם וַעֲצַ֖ת נִפְתָּלִ֣ים נִמְהָֽרָה׃

records.literal_gloss: [who] catches [the] wise in their craftiness, and [the] counsel of [the] twisted [ones] is hurried.

en.L: [He] catches [the] wise in their craftiness, \q and [the] counsel of [the] twisted is rushed [to its end].
en.B: He catches the wise in their own cunning, \q and the schemes of the devious are swept away.
en.R: He traps clever people with their own tricks, \q and the plans of dishonest people quickly fall apart.

es.L: [Él] atrapa a [los] sabios en su astucia, \q y [el] consejo de [los] retorcidos se precipita [a su fin].
es.B: Atrapa a los sabios en su propia astucia, \q y las maquinaciones de los perversos son arrasadas.
es.R: Atrapa a los listos en sus propios trucos, \q y los planes de los deshonestos se vienen abajo enseguida.

fr.L: [Il] prend [les] sages dans leur ruse, \q et [le] conseil des tortueux est précipité [vers sa fin].
fr.B: Il prend les sages au piège de leur propre ruse, \q et les intrigues des fourbes sont emportées.
fr.R: Il attrape les gens habiles dans leurs propres ruses, \q et les plans des malhonnêtes s’effondrent vite.

sw.L: [Yeye] huwakamata wenye hekima kwa ujanja wao, \q na shauri la wapotovu huharakishwa [hadi mwisho wake].
sw.B: Huwanasa wenye hekima kwa werevu wao wenyewe, \q na hila za wadanganyifu hufagiliwa mbali.
sw.R: Huwakamata watu wajanja kwa hila zao wenyewe, \q na mipango ya watu wasio waaminifu huanguka upesi.

vi.L: [Ngài] bắt những người khôn ngoan trong sự xảo quyệt của họ, \q và mưu kế của kẻ quanh co bị đẩy vội [đến chỗ tàn].
vi.B: Ngài bắt người khôn ngoan trong chính mưu mẹo của họ, \q và mưu đồ của kẻ gian tà bị cuốn phăng đi.
vi.R: Ngài gài bẫy người khôn lanh bằng chính mánh khóe của họ, \q và kế hoạch của kẻ gian dối nhanh chóng sụp đổ.

ko.L: [그분은] 지혜로운 자들을 그들의 간교함으로 잡으시니, \q 비뚤어진 자들의 계략이 서둘러 [끝나 버리오].
ko.B: 그분은 지혜로운 자들을 그들 자신의 꾀로 붙잡으시니, \q 간사한 자들의 계략은 휩쓸려 가 버리오.
ko.R: 그분은 똑똑한 사람들을 그들 자신의 잔꾀로 붙잡으시니, \q 정직하지 못한 사람들의 계획은 금세 무너지오.

decisions.choice: quoted by Paul
decisions.reason: Paul quotes the first line in 1 Corinthians 3:19, "He catches the wise in their craftiness". It is the one clear quotation of Job in the New Testament. Paul accepts the truth of Eliphaz's words even though, at the end, God says the friends did not speak rightly of him (42:7).

decisions.choice: the twisted: devious, crooked people
decisions.reason: Niftalim are those who twist and wrestle (the same root as Genesis 30:8; Proverbs 8:8): crooked in their dealings.

decisions.choice: hurried: their plan is carried along too fast and comes to nothing
decisions.reason: Nimharah means rushed, hasty. The schemers' plan is swept headlong, before it can succeed, and so it fails.

decisions.choice: are swept away
decisions.reason: Balanced says what the hurry leads to (m3); Literal keeps "rushed".

decisions.choice: "atrapa a los sabios en su astucia"
alternatives: "prende a los sabios en su sagacidad"
decisions.reason: Paul quotes this line in 1 Corinthians 3:19; the Spanish keeps the key words of the published Spanish there ("atrapa", "astucia") so a reader can see the quotation, while the rest is drafted from the Hebrew.

source.text: יוֹמָ֥ם יְפַגְּשׁוּ־חֹ֑שֶׁךְ וְ֝כַלַּ֗יְלָה יְֽמַשְׁשׁ֥וּ בַֽצָּהֳרָֽיִם׃

records.literal_gloss: By day they meet darkness, and as [at] night they grope at noon.

en.L: By day they meet darkness, \q and as [at] night they grope at noon.
en.B: In the daytime they run into darkness, \q and at noon they grope as if it were night.
en.R: Even in the daytime it is dark for them; \q at noon they feel their way around as if it were night.

es.L: De día se topan con [las] tinieblas, \q y como [de] noche andan a tientas al mediodía.
es.B: En pleno día tropiezan con la oscuridad, \q y al mediodía andan a tientas como si fuera de noche.
es.R: Aun de día todo está oscuro para ellos; \q al mediodía van palpando como si fuera de noche.

fr.L: De jour ils rencontrent les ténèbres, \q et comme [de] nuit ils tâtonnent à midi.
fr.B: En plein jour ils se heurtent aux ténèbres, \q à midi ils tâtonnent comme en pleine nuit.
fr.R: Même le jour, il fait noir pour eux ; \q à midi ils avancent à tâtons comme s’il faisait nuit.

sw.L: Mchana wanakutana na giza, \q na kama usiku wanapapasa adhuhuri.
sw.B: Wakati wa mchana wanakumbana na giza, \q adhuhuri wanapapasa kana kwamba ni usiku.
sw.R: Hata mchana kwao ni giza; \q adhuhuri wanatembea kwa kupapasa kana kwamba ni usiku.

vi.L: Ban ngày chúng gặp bóng tối, \q và như [ban] đêm chúng mò mẫm lúc giữa trưa.
vi.B: Giữa ban ngày chúng đụng phải bóng tối, \q lúc giữa trưa chúng mò mẫm như trong đêm.
vi.R: Ngay cả ban ngày chúng cũng thấy tối tăm; \q giữa trưa chúng phải lần mò như thể đang đêm.

ko.L: 낮에 그들은 어둠을 만나고, \q 한낮에 밤[인 것]처럼 더듬소.
ko.B: 그들은 대낮에도 어둠과 마주치고, \q 한낮에도 밤처럼 더듬거리오.
ko.R: 그들에게는 낮에도 캄캄하오. \q 한낮에도 밤인 것처럼 더듬으며 다니오.

decisions.choice: groping at noon: a covenant curse
decisions.reason: Deuteronomy 28:29 warns that the disobedient will grope at noon as the blind grope in the dark. The crafty, for all their cleverness, cannot see their way.

decisions.choice: darkness by day: confusion, being lost
decisions.reason: Darkness at the time of light is a picture of complete confusion and failure (Isaiah 59:10).

source.text: וַיֹּ֣שַׁע מֵ֭חֶרֶב מִפִּיהֶ֑ם וּמִיַּ֖ד חָזָ֣ק אֶבְיֽוֹן׃

records.literal_gloss: And he saves from [the] sword, from their mouth, and from [the] hand of [the] strong [the] needy.

en.L: And {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} saves from [the] sword, from their mouth, \q and from [the] hand of [the] strong, [the] needy.
en.B: But {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} saves the needy from the sword of their mouths \q and from the grip of the powerful.
en.R: But God saves people in need from the cutting words of the powerful \q and from their grip.

es.L: Y {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} salva de [la] espada, de su boca, \q y de [la] mano del fuerte, al necesitado.
es.B: Pero {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} salva al necesitado de la espada de sus bocas \q y de la mano del poderoso.
es.R: Pero Dios salva a los necesitados de las palabras hirientes de los poderosos \q y de sus garras.

fr.L: Et {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} sauve de [l’]épée, de leur bouche, \q et de [la] main du fort, [le] pauvre.
fr.B: Mais {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} sauve le pauvre de l’épée de leur bouche \q et de la poigne des puissants.
fr.R: Mais Dieu sauve les gens dans le besoin des paroles tranchantes des puissants \q et de leur poigne.

sw.L: Naye huokoa kutoka upanga, kutoka kinywa chao, \q na kutoka mkono wa mwenye nguvu, mhitaji.
sw.B: Lakini {{deity_pronoun:yeye|Yeye}} humwokoa mhitaji kutoka upanga wa vinywa vyao \q na kutoka mkononi mwa wenye nguvu.
sw.R: Lakini Mungu huwaokoa wahitaji kutoka maneno makali ya wenye nguvu \q na kutoka mikononi mwao.

vi.L: Và {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} cứu khỏi gươm, khỏi miệng chúng, \q và khỏi tay kẻ mạnh, [người] thiếu thốn.
vi.B: Nhưng {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} cứu người thiếu thốn khỏi lưỡi gươm nơi miệng chúng \q và khỏi tay kẻ quyền thế.
vi.R: Nhưng Đức Chúa Trời cứu người nghèo khó khỏi những lời cay độc của kẻ quyền thế \q và khỏi tay chúng.

ko.L: 그분은 칼에서, 그들의 입에서, \q 강한 자의 손에서 궁핍한 자를 구원하시오.
ko.B: 그러나 그분은 궁핍한 사람을 그들의 입에서 나오는 칼과 \q 권세 있는 자의 손아귀에서 구하시오.
ko.R: 하지만 하나님께서는 힘 있는 자들의 날카로운 말과 \q 그들의 손아귀에서 가난한 사람들을 건지시는 분이오.

decisions.choice: from the sword, from their mouth: the sword that is their mouth
alternatives: from the sword of their mouth, and the orphan from the hand of the strong (a slightly different text)
decisions.reason: The two phrases stand side by side: the sword is the mouth of the crafty, their harsh and lying words (Psalm 57:5; 59:8; 64:4). Some read one letter differently and get "the orphan" in place of "from their mouth", to pair with "the needy". The text as it stands makes good sense.

decisions.choice: the needy: the poor, those who depend on others
decisions.reason: 'Evyon is the poor person who has no means of his own (Deuteronomy 15:4, 11). The word stands at the end and belongs to both lines: God rescues the needy from the sword and from the strong hand.

decisions.choice: the hand of the strong: their power
decisions.reason: "Hand" often stands for power or control (5:20; 6:23).

decisions.choice: God
decisions.reason: Readable names God, since the subject is several verses back (5:8).

source.text: וַתְּהִ֣י לַדַּ֣ל תִּקְוָ֑ה וְ֝עֹלָ֗תָה קָ֣פְצָה פִּֽיהָ׃

records.literal_gloss: And there is for the poor hope, and injustice shuts its mouth.

en.L: So there is hope for the poor, \q and injustice shuts its mouth.
en.B: So the poor have hope, \q and injustice shuts its mouth.
en.R: So poor people have hope, \q and wrongdoing is silenced.

es.L: Así hay esperanza para el pobre, \q y la injusticia cierra su boca.
es.B: Así el pobre tiene esperanza, \q y la injusticia cierra la boca.
es.R: Así los pobres tienen esperanza, \q y la maldad queda callada.

fr.L: Ainsi il y a de l’espérance pour le faible, \q et l’injustice ferme sa bouche.
fr.B: Ainsi le pauvre a de l’espoir, \q et l’injustice ferme la bouche.
fr.R: Alors les pauvres ont de l’espoir, \q et le mal est réduit au silence.

sw.L: Hivyo maskini ana tumaini, \q na uovu hufumba kinywa chake.
sw.B: Hivyo maskini wana tumaini, \q na udhalimu hufunga kinywa chake.
sw.R: Hivyo watu maskini wana tumaini, \q na uovu hunyamazishwa.

vi.L: Vậy kẻ nghèo có hy vọng, \q và sự bất công phải ngậm miệng.
vi.B: Vậy người nghèo có niềm hy vọng, \q còn sự bất công phải câm miệng.
vi.R: Vậy người nghèo có hy vọng, \q và điều gian ác phải im tiếng.

ko.L: 그리하여 가난한 자에게 소망이 있고, \q 불의는 그 입을 다무오.
ko.B: 그래서 가난한 사람에게 소망이 있고, \q 불의는 입을 다물게 되오.
ko.R: 그래서 가난한 사람들이 희망을 갖게 되고, \q 나쁜 짓은 잠잠해지오.

decisions.choice: injustice shuts its mouth
decisions.reason: Psalm 107:42 uses the same picture: when God lifts the needy, all wickedness shuts its mouth. Injustice is pictured as a person who had much to say and now falls silent.

decisions.choice: the poor: the weak, those of low standing
decisions.reason: Dal is someone poor and powerless, without influence (Leviticus 14:21; Proverbs 22:22).

decisions.choice: so: the result of God's rescue
decisions.reason: The verb continues the story of verse 15: because God saves the needy, the poor have hope.

decisions.choice: wrongdoing is silenced
decisions.reason: Readable says what the picture means (m1).

source.text: הִנֵּ֤ה אַשְׁרֵ֣י אֱ֭נוֹשׁ יוֹכִחֶ֣נּֽוּ אֱל֑וֹהַּ וּמוּסַ֥ר שַׁ֝דַּ֗י אַל־תִּמְאָֽס׃

records.literal_gloss: Look, how blessed [is] [the] person [whom] God reproves; and [the] discipline of [the] Almighty do not reject.

en.L: Look, how blessed [is] {{gender:the person|the man}} whom God corrects; \q so do not reject [the] discipline of the Almighty.
en.B: How blessed is {{gender:the one|the man}} whom God corrects! \q So do not reject the discipline of the Almighty.
en.R: The person God corrects is truly blessed, \q so do not refuse it when God All-Powerful disciplines you.

es.L: Mira, dichoso {{gender:el ser humano|el hombre}} a quien Dios corrige; \q no rechaces, pues, [la] disciplina del Todopoderoso.
es.B: ¡{{gender:Dichosa la persona|Dichoso el hombre}} a quien Dios corrige! \q Así que no rechaces la disciplina del Todopoderoso.
es.R: Quien es corregido por Dios es de verdad dichoso, \q así que no lo rechaces cuando el Dios Todopoderoso te discipline.

fr.L: Voici, heureux {{gender:l’être humain|l’homme}} que Dieu reprend ; \q ne rejette donc pas [la] correction du Tout-Puissant.
fr.B: Heureux celui que Dieu corrige ! \q Ne rejette donc pas la correction du Tout-Puissant.
fr.R: Celui que Dieu corrige est vraiment heureux ; \q alors ne refuse pas la correction de Dieu le Tout-Puissant.

sw.L: Tazama, heri mtu ambaye Mungu humkaripia; \q basi usiikatae nidhamu ya Mwenyezi.
sw.B: Heri mtu ambaye Mungu humrudi! \q Basi usikatae nidhamu ya Mwenyezi.
sw.R: Mtu ambaye Mungu humrekebisha amebarikiwa kweli, \q kwa hiyo usikatae Mungu Mwenyezi anapokuadibisha.

vi.L: Kìa, phước thay người mà Đức Chúa Trời quở trách; \q vậy chớ khinh bỏ sự sửa phạt của Đấng Toàn Năng.
vi.B: Phước thay người được Đức Chúa Trời sửa dạy! \q Vậy đừng khước từ sự sửa phạt của Đấng Toàn Năng.
vi.R: Người được Đức Chúa Trời sửa dạy thật có phước, \q nên anh đừng từ chối khi Đức Chúa Trời Toàn Năng sửa phạt anh.

ko.L: 보시오, 하나님께서 꾸짖으시는 사람은 복이 있으니, \q 전능자의 징계를 거절하지 마시오.
ko.B: 하나님께서 바로잡아 주시는 사람은 얼마나 복된가! \q 그러니 전능자의 징계를 물리치지 마시오.
ko.R: 하나님께서 바로잡아 주시는 사람은 참으로 복을 받은 사람이오. \q 그러니 전능하신 하나님께서 그대를 훈계하실 때 거부하지 마시오.

decisions.choice: how blessed: an exclamation about a life that goes well
decisions.reason: The word ('ashre) is the one that opens Psalm 1: "oh, the blessings of ...". Eliphaz says that God's correction is a sign of his care, not of his rejection.

decisions.choice: the Almighty: Shaddai, an ancient name of God
decisions.reason: Shaddai is one of the oldest names of God, used by the patriarchs (Genesis 17:1; Exodus 6:3), and it appears more often in Job than in any other book. Its origin is uncertain; since the ancient Greek translation it has been taken as "the Almighty". This is its first use in Job.

decisions.choice: the discipline of the Lord
decisions.reason: Proverbs 3:11-12 says the same thing in nearly the same words: do not reject the Lord's discipline, for he corrects the one he loves; Hebrews 12:5-6 quotes Proverbs. Eliphaz assumes that Job is being corrected for some fault; the reader knows from chapters 1-2 that this is not why Job suffers.

decisions.choice: the person: any human being
decisions.reason: 'Enosh is a human being, frail and mortal, not only a male.

decisions.choice: God All-Powerful
decisions.reason: Readable says "God All-Powerful" for Shaddai in every book, so that a young reader knows the name refers to God.

decisions.choice: no "Look"
decisions.reason: Hinneh draws attention; Balanced and Readable carry it with the exclamation instead of a separate word. Literal keeps "Look".

decisions.choice: "Heureux celui que Dieu corrige" with no gender span
decisions.reason: French "celui que" already means anyone, man or woman, so Balanced needs no gender span where the English has one; Literal keeps the noun ("l'être humain" / "l'homme") under the setting.

source.text: כִּ֤י ה֣וּא יַכְאִ֣יב וְיֶחְבָּ֑שׁ יִ֝מְחַ֗ץ וְיָדָ֥יו תִּרְפֶּֽינָה׃

records.literal_gloss: For he causes pain and he binds up; he smashes, and his hands heal.

en.L: For {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} causes pain and binds up; \q {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} strikes, and {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} hands heal.
en.B: For {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} wounds, but {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} also binds up; \q {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} strikes, but {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} hands heal.
en.R: God may hurt you, but then {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} bandages the wound; \q {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} strikes, but {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} hands bring healing.

es.L: Porque {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} hace sufrir y venda; \q hiere, y {{deity_pronoun:sus|Sus}} manos sanan.
es.B: Porque {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} hiere, pero también venda; \q golpea, pero {{deity_pronoun:sus|Sus}} manos curan.
es.R: Dios puede hacerte daño, pero luego venda la herida; \q golpea, pero {{deity_pronoun:sus|Sus}} manos sanan.

fr.L: Car {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} fait souffrir et panse ; \q {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} frappe, et {{deity_pronoun:ses|Ses}} mains guérissent.
fr.B: Car {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} blesse, mais {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} panse aussi ; \q {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} frappe, mais {{deity_pronoun:ses|Ses}} mains guérissent.
fr.R: Dieu peut te faire mal, mais ensuite {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} soigne la blessure ; \q {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} frappe, mais {{deity_pronoun:ses|Ses}} mains guérissent.

sw.L: Kwa maana {{deity_pronoun:yeye|Yeye}} huumiza na kufunga jeraha; \q hupiga, na mikono {{deity_pronoun:yake|Yake}} huponya.
sw.B: Kwa maana {{deity_pronoun:yeye|Yeye}} hujeruhi, lakini pia hufunga jeraha; \q hupiga, lakini mikono {{deity_pronoun:yake|Yake}} huponya.
sw.R: Mungu anaweza kukuumiza, lakini kisha hufunga jeraha; \q hupiga, lakini mikono {{deity_pronoun:yake|Yake}} huleta uponyaji.

vi.L: Vì {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} làm cho đau đớn rồi băng bó; \q {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đánh, và tay {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} chữa lành.
vi.B: Vì {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} gây thương tích nhưng cũng băng bó; \q {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đánh nhưng tay {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} chữa lành.
vi.R: Đức Chúa Trời có thể làm anh đau, nhưng rồi {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} băng bó vết thương; \q {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đánh, nhưng tay {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} chữa lành.

ko.L: 그분은 아프게 하시고 싸매시며, \q 치시고 그 손으로 고치시는 분이오.
ko.B: 그분은 상처를 입히시나 싸매기도 하시고, \q 치시나 그 손으로 낫게 하신다오.
ko.R: 하나님께서 그대를 아프게 하실 수도 있지만 곧 상처를 싸매 주시고, \q 치시더라도 그 손으로 고쳐 주신다오.

decisions.choice: God wounds and heals
decisions.reason: Deuteronomy 32:39 ("I wound and I heal") and Hosea 6:1 ("he has torn us, and he will heal us") say the same: the God who strikes is the God who restores.

decisions.choice: his hands, as the scribes' reading has it
decisions.reason: The written consonants (ketiv) read "his hand"; the reading the scribes marked (qere) is "his hands". The meaning is the same.

decisions.choice: he: God himself, with emphasis
decisions.reason: The pronoun is written out for emphasis: the one who wounds is the very one who heals.

decisions.choice: God may hurt you
decisions.reason: Readable names God and the person hurt, which the Hebrew leaves to the context.

source.text: בְּשֵׁ֣שׁ צָ֭רוֹת יַצִּילֶ֑ךָּ וּבְשֶׁ֓בַע׀לֹא־יִגַּ֖ע בְּךָ֣ רָֽע׃

records.literal_gloss: In six troubles he will deliver you, and in seven not will touch you harm.

en.L: In six troubles {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} will deliver you, \q and in seven, harm will not touch you.
en.B: He will rescue you from six troubles; \q in seven, no harm will touch you.
en.R: He will rescue you from trouble again and again; \q no matter how many times, nothing bad will touch you.

es.L: En seis angustias {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} te librará, \q y en siete, el mal no te tocará.
es.B: Te rescatará de seis angustias; \q en siete, ningún mal te tocará.
es.R: Te rescatará de los problemas una y otra vez; \q no importa cuántas veces, nada malo te tocará.

fr.L: En six détresses {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} te délivrera, \q et dans sept, le mal ne te touchera pas.
fr.B: Il te sauvera de six détresses ; \q dans sept, aucun mal ne t’atteindra.
fr.R: Il te sauvera du malheur encore et encore ; \q peu importe combien de fois, rien de mauvais ne t’atteindra.

sw.L: Katika taabu sita atakuokoa, \q na katika saba, uovu hautakugusa.
sw.B: Atakuokoa katika taabu sita; \q hata katika saba, hakuna baya litakalokugusa.
sw.R: Atakuokoa katika matatizo tena na tena; \q haijalishi ni mara ngapi, hakuna baya litakalokupata.

vi.L: Trong sáu cơn hoạn nạn {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} sẽ giải cứu anh, \q và trong bảy [cơn], tai họa sẽ không chạm đến anh.
vi.B: Ngài sẽ cứu anh khỏi sáu cơn hoạn nạn; \q dù đến bảy cơn, chẳng tai họa nào chạm đến anh.
vi.R: Ngài sẽ cứu anh khỏi rắc rối hết lần này đến lần khác; \q dù bao nhiêu lần đi nữa, chẳng điều dữ nào chạm đến anh.

ko.L: 여섯 가지 환난에서 그분이 그대를 건지시고, \q 일곱 가지에서도 재앙이 그대에게 닿지 못하오.
ko.B: 그분은 여섯 가지 환난에서 그대를 구하시고, \q 일곱 가지 환난에도 어떤 해도 그대에게 미치지 못하오.
ko.R: 그분은 어려움이 닥칠 때마다 그대를 구해 내실 것이오. \q 몇 번이 되든 나쁜 일이 그대에게 닿지 못하오.

decisions.choice: six, seven: trouble after trouble, as many as there are
decisions.reason: A number followed by the next number is a way of saying "many" or "every one" in Hebrew poetry (Proverbs 6:16; 30:15-31; Amos 1:3). The point is not the count but that God's help never runs out.

decisions.choice: harm: evil, anything bad
decisions.reason: Ra' covers both moral evil and misfortune; here it is harm that happens to a person.

decisions.choice: again and again, no matter how many times
decisions.reason: Readable explains the number saying (m1).

source.text: בְּ֭רָעָב פָּֽדְךָ֣ מִמָּ֑וֶת וּ֝בְמִלְחָמָ֗ה מִ֣ידֵי חָֽרֶב׃

records.literal_gloss: In famine he will ransom you from death, and in battle from [the] hands of [the] sword.

en.L: In famine {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} will ransom you from death, \q and in war from [the] hands of [the] sword.
en.B: In famine {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} will redeem you from death, \q and in war from the power of the sword.
en.R: When there is no food, {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} will save you from dying; \q in war {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} will keep you from being killed.

es.L: En el hambre {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} te redimirá de la muerte, \q y en la guerra, de [las] manos de [la] espada.
es.B: En tiempo de hambre {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} te rescatará de la muerte, \q y en la guerra, del poder de la espada.
es.R: Cuando no haya comida, {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} te salvará de morir; \q en la guerra {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} impedirá que te maten.

fr.L: Dans la famine {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} te rachètera de la mort, \q et dans la guerre, des mains de l’épée.
fr.B: Dans la famine {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} te libérera de la mort, \q et dans la guerre, du pouvoir de l’épée.
fr.R: Quand il n’y aura plus de nourriture, {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} te sauvera de la mort ; \q à la guerre, {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} t’empêchera d’être tué.

sw.L: Wakati wa njaa atakukomboa kutoka mautini, \q na vitani kutoka mikononi mwa upanga.
sw.B: Wakati wa njaa atakukomboa na kifo, \q na wakati wa vita na nguvu za upanga.
sw.R: Chakula kitakapokosekana, atakuokoa usife; \q vitani atakulinda usiuawe.

vi.L: Trong cơn đói kém {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} sẽ chuộc anh khỏi sự chết, \q và trong chiến tranh, khỏi tay của gươm.
vi.B: Trong nạn đói {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} sẽ chuộc anh khỏi cái chết, \q và trong chiến trận, khỏi quyền lực của lưỡi gươm.
vi.R: Khi không còn thức ăn, {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} sẽ cứu anh khỏi chết; \q khi có chiến tranh, {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} sẽ giữ anh khỏi bị giết.

ko.L: 기근 때에 그분이 그대를 죽음에서 속량하시고, \q 전쟁 때에 칼의 손에서 [건지실 것이오].
ko.B: 기근 때에는 그분이 그대를 죽음에서 건져 내시고, \q 전쟁 때에는 칼의 권세에서 건지실 것이오.
ko.R: 먹을 것이 없을 때에도 그분은 그대가 죽지 않게 지켜 주시고, \q 전쟁 때에도 그대가 죽임을 당하지 않게 하실 것이오.

decisions.choice: ransom: set free, rescue
decisions.reason: Padah is to free someone, often by a payment, but when God is the subject no price is named (Deuteronomy 7:8; Psalm 25:22). Job will use the word in 6:23.

decisions.choice: a past form for a sure future
decisions.reason: The verb is in the form normally used for completed action; here it states as certain what God will do.

decisions.choice: the hands of the sword: the power of the sword
decisions.reason: The sword is pictured with hands; it means death in battle. The reader remembers that Job's servants were killed by the sword (1:15, 17).

decisions.choice: keep you from being killed
alternatives: from the hands of the sword
decisions.reason: Readable says plainly what the picture means (m3).

source.text: בְּשׁ֣וֹט לָ֭שׁוֹן תֵּחָבֵ֑א וְֽלֹא־תִירָ֥א מִ֝שֹּׁ֗ד כִּ֣י יָבֽוֹא׃

records.literal_gloss: In [the] whip of [the] tongue you will be hidden, and not you will be afraid of destruction when it comes.

en.L: From [the] whip of [the] tongue you will be hidden, \q and you will not be afraid of destruction when it comes.
en.B: You will be sheltered from the lash of the tongue, \q and you will not fear destruction when it comes.
en.R: You will be protected when people attack you with words, \q and you will not be afraid when disaster comes.

es.L: Del látigo de [la] lengua serás escondido, \q y no temerás la destrucción cuando venga.
es.B: Estarás a cubierto del azote de la lengua, \q y no temerás la destrucción cuando llegue.
es.R: Estarás protegido cuando la gente te ataque con palabras, \q y no tendrás miedo cuando llegue el desastre.

fr.L: Du fouet de la langue tu seras caché, \q et tu ne craindras pas la dévastation quand elle viendra.
fr.B: Tu seras à l’abri du fouet de la langue, \q et tu ne craindras pas la dévastation quand elle viendra.
fr.R: Tu seras protégé quand on t’attaquera avec des mots, \q et tu n’auras pas peur quand le désastre arrivera.

sw.L: Kutoka mjeledi wa ulimi utafichwa, \q wala hutaogopa maangamizi yatakapokuja.
sw.B: Utahifadhiwa mbali na mapigo ya ulimi, \q wala hutaogopa maangamizi yatakapokuja.
sw.R: Utalindwa watu watakapokushambulia kwa maneno, \q wala hutaogopa msiba utakapokuja.

vi.L: Khỏi roi của lưỡi anh sẽ được che giấu, \q và anh sẽ chẳng sợ sự tàn phá khi nó đến.
vi.B: Anh sẽ được che chở khỏi ngọn roi của miệng lưỡi, \q và chẳng sợ sự tàn phá khi nó ập đến.
vi.R: Anh sẽ được bảo vệ khi người ta dùng lời nói để tấn công anh, \q và anh sẽ không sợ khi tai họa xảy đến.

ko.L: 혀의 채찍에서 그대가 숨겨지고, \q 파멸이 올 때에도 그대는 두려워하지 않을 것이오.
ko.B: 그대는 혀의 채찍질에서 보호받고, \q 파멸이 닥쳐도 두려워하지 않을 것이오.
ko.R: 사람들이 말로 그대를 공격해도 그대는 보호받고, \q 재난이 닥쳐도 두려워하지 않을 것이오.

decisions.choice: the whip of the tongue: slander, wounding words
decisions.reason: Words that wound are pictured as a whip (Psalm 31:21; Jeremiah 18:18). God will hide the righteous from them.

decisions.choice: destruction: violent ruin, devastation
decisions.reason: Shod is ruin that falls suddenly, by raiders or by storm (Isaiah 13:6). The same word begins verse 22.

decisions.choice: when people attack you with words
decisions.reason: Readable explains the picture (m1).

source.text: לְשֹׁ֣ד וּלְכָפָ֣ן תִּשְׂחָ֑ק וּֽמֵחַיַּ֥ת הָ֝אָ֗רֶץ אַל־תִּירָֽא׃

records.literal_gloss: At destruction and at famine you will laugh, and of [the] beasts of the earth do not be afraid.

en.L: At destruction and at famine you will laugh, \q and of [the] beasts of the earth you need not be afraid.
en.B: You will laugh at destruction and hunger, \q and you need not fear the wild animals of the earth.
en.R: You will laugh at disaster and hunger, \q and you will not be afraid of wild animals.

es.L: De la destrucción y del hambre te reirás, \q y de [las] fieras de la tierra no tendrás que temer.
es.B: Te reirás de la destrucción y del hambre, \q y no tendrás que temer a las fieras de la tierra.
es.R: Te reirás del desastre y del hambre, \q y no tendrás miedo de los animales salvajes.

fr.L: De la dévastation et de la famine tu riras, \q et des bêtes de la terre tu n’auras pas à avoir peur.
fr.B: Tu riras de la dévastation et de la faim, \q et tu n’auras pas à craindre les bêtes sauvages de la terre.
fr.R: Tu riras du désastre et de la faim, \q et tu n’auras pas peur des bêtes sauvages.

sw.L: Maangamizi na njaa utayacheka, \q na wanyama wa nchi huna haja ya kuwaogopa.
sw.B: Utacheka maangamizi na njaa, \q wala huna haja ya kuwaogopa wanyama wa mwituni.
sw.R: Utaucheka msiba na njaa, \q wala hutawaogopa wanyama wa porini.

vi.L: Trước sự tàn phá và nạn đói anh sẽ cười, \q và với thú vật của đất anh chẳng cần phải sợ.
vi.B: Anh sẽ cười trước sự tàn phá và đói kém, \q và chẳng cần sợ thú dữ trên đất.
vi.R: Anh sẽ cười trước tai họa và đói khát, \q và anh sẽ không sợ thú hoang.

ko.L: 파멸과 기근을 그대가 비웃을 것이고, \q 땅의 짐승들을 두려워할 필요가 없소.
ko.B: 그대는 파멸과 굶주림을 비웃을 것이고, \q 땅의 들짐승들도 두려워할 필요가 없소.
ko.R: 그대는 재난과 굶주림을 보고도 웃을 것이고, \q 들짐승도 무서워하지 않을 것이오.

decisions.choice: laugh: be unafraid, confident
decisions.reason: To laugh at a danger is to have no fear of it (Job 39:7, 18, 22; 41:21).

decisions.choice: famine: hunger
decisions.reason: Kafan is a rare word for famine, different from the word in verse 20; the meaning is the same.

decisions.choice: do not be afraid: an assurance, you need not fear
decisions.reason: The negative with this verb form is usually a command, but in a list of promises it reassures: there will be nothing to fear.

decisions.choice: you need not be afraid
decisions.reason: "Need not" keeps the sense of reassurance (m3) and the flow of the promises.

source.text: כִּ֤י עִם־אַבְנֵ֣י הַשָּׂדֶ֣ה בְרִיתֶ֑ךָ וְחַיַּ֥ת הַ֝שָּׂדֶ֗ה הָשְׁלְמָה־לָֽךְ׃

records.literal_gloss: For with [the] stones of the field [will be] your covenant, and [the] beasts of the field will be at peace with you.

en.L: For with the stones of the field [will be] your covenant, \q and the beasts of the field will be at peace with you.
en.B: For you will be in covenant with the stones of the field, \q and the wild animals will be at peace with you.
en.R: You will be at peace even with the stones in your fields, \q and the wild animals will live at peace with you.

es.L: Porque con las piedras del campo [estará] tu pacto, \q y las fieras del campo estarán en paz contigo.
es.B: Porque tendrás un pacto con las piedras del campo, \q y las fieras vivirán en paz contigo.
es.R: Estarás en paz aun con las piedras de tus campos, \q y los animales salvajes vivirán en paz contigo.

fr.L: Car avec les pierres des champs [sera] ton alliance, \q et les bêtes des champs seront en paix avec toi.
fr.B: Car tu seras en alliance avec les pierres des champs, \q et les bêtes sauvages vivront en paix avec toi.
fr.R: Tu seras en paix même avec les pierres de tes champs, \q et les bêtes sauvages vivront en paix avec toi.

sw.L: Kwa maana pamoja na mawe ya shambani [litakuwa] agano lako, \q na wanyama wa shambani watakuwa na amani nawe.
sw.B: Kwa maana utakuwa na agano na mawe ya shambani, \q na wanyama wa porini watakaa nawe kwa amani.
sw.R: Utakuwa na amani hata na mawe yaliyo mashambani mwako, \q na wanyama wa porini wataishi nawe kwa amani.

vi.L: Vì với đá ngoài đồng [sẽ có] giao ước của anh, \q và thú đồng sẽ hòa thuận với anh.
vi.B: Vì anh sẽ lập giao ước với đá ngoài đồng, \q và thú hoang sẽ sống hòa thuận với anh.
vi.R: Anh sẽ được bình yên ngay cả với đá trong ruộng mình, \q và thú hoang sẽ sống hòa thuận với anh.

ko.L: 들의 돌들과 그대의 언약이 [있을 것이고], \q 들짐승들이 그대와 화목하게 될 것이오.
ko.B: 그대는 들의 돌들과도 언약을 맺고, \q 들짐승들도 그대와 평화롭게 지낼 것이오.
ko.R: 그대는 밭에 있는 돌들과도 사이좋게 지내고, \q 들짐승들도 그대와 평화롭게 살 것이오.

decisions.choice: a covenant with the stones: the land itself will not work against you
alternatives: the stones will be your allies
decisions.reason: Stones in a field spoil the ground for plowing (2 Kings 3:19, 25; Isaiah 5:2). To be in covenant with them means they will do no harm to your crops: creation itself will be at peace with the righteous, as in Hosea 2:20 and Isaiah 11:6-9.

decisions.choice: the beasts of the field: wild animals
decisions.reason: "Animals of the field" are the wild animals, as in verse 22.

decisions.choice: be at peace: be brought into peace with you
decisions.reason: The verb (from shalem) is passive: the animals are made to be at peace with you, as partners in the same covenant.

decisions.choice: at peace
decisions.reason: Readable uses "at peace" for the covenant with the stones, since "covenant" with stones is hard to picture; the second line shows the sense (m1).

source.text: וְֽ֭יָדַעְתָּ כִּי־שָׁל֣וֹם אָהֳלֶ֑ךָ וּֽפָקַדְתָּ֥ נָ֝וְךָ וְלֹ֣א תֶחֱטָֽא׃

records.literal_gloss: And you will know that peace [is] your tent, and you will visit your dwelling and not miss.

en.L: And you will know that your tent [is] at peace, \q and you will visit your homestead and not miss [anything].
en.B: You will know that your home is secure; \q you will look over your property and find nothing missing.
en.R: You will know that your home is safe; \q you will check on your land and animals and find that nothing is missing.

es.L: Y sabrás que tu tienda [está] en paz, \q y visitarás tu morada y no echarás de menos [nada].
es.B: Sabrás que tu hogar está seguro; \q revisarás tus bienes y no faltará nada.
es.R: Sabrás que tu casa está a salvo; \q revisarás tus tierras y tus animales, y verás que no falta nada.

fr.L: Et tu sauras que ta tente [est] en paix, \q et tu visiteras ton domaine et il ne te manquera [rien].
fr.B: Tu sauras que ta demeure est en sûreté ; \q tu inspecteras tes biens et rien ne manquera.
fr.R: Tu sauras que ta maison est en sécurité ; \q tu iras voir tes terres et tes bêtes, et rien ne manquera.

sw.L: Nawe utajua kwamba hema lako [li] salama, \q nawe utakagua makao yako wala hutakosa [kitu].
sw.B: Utajua kwamba nyumba yako iko salama; \q utakagua mali yako usikose chochote.
sw.R: Utajua kwamba nyumba yako iko salama; \q utakagua mashamba na mifugo yako na kuona kwamba hakuna kinachokosekana.

vi.L: Và anh sẽ biết rằng lều anh [được] bình an, \q và anh sẽ thăm nơi ở của mình mà chẳng thiếu [gì].
vi.B: Anh sẽ biết nhà mình được yên ổn; \q anh sẽ kiểm tra tài sản mà chẳng thấy thiếu gì.
vi.R: Anh sẽ biết nhà mình được an toàn; \q anh sẽ đi xem đất đai và bầy súc vật mà thấy không thiếu gì cả.

ko.L: 그대는 그대의 장막이 평안함을 알게 되고, \q 그대의 거처를 살펴도 잃은 것이 없을 것이오.
ko.B: 그대는 그대의 집이 안전함을 알게 되고, \q 재산을 살펴보아도 없어진 것이 하나도 없을 것이오.
ko.R: 그대는 그대의 집이 안전하다는 것을 알게 되고, \q 땅과 가축을 살펴보아도 없어진 것이 하나도 없을 것이오.

decisions.choice: not miss: find nothing lacking
decisions.reason: The verb chata' usually means to sin, but its older sense is to miss a mark (Judges 20:16). When you count what you own, nothing will be missing.

decisions.choice: dwelling: homestead, pasture and flocks
decisions.reason: Naveh is a dwelling or pasture (5:3). Beside "tent" it means the whole homestead with its flocks.

decisions.choice: your tent is at peace: your home is safe
decisions.reason: "Tent" is home, from the days of living in tents. Shalom is wholeness and safety.

decisions.choice: your land and animals
decisions.reason: Readable spells out what a homestead held (m2).

source.text: וְֽ֭יָדַעְתָּ כִּי־רַ֣ב זַרְעֶ֑ךָ וְ֝צֶאֱצָאֶ֗יךָ כְּעֵ֣שֶׂב הָאָֽרֶץ׃

records.literal_gloss: And you will know that many [is] your offspring, and your descendants like the grass of the earth.

en.L: And you will know that your offspring [will be] many, \q and your descendants like the grass of the earth.
en.B: You will know that your offspring will be many, \q your descendants like the grass of the earth.
en.R: You will see that you will have many children, \q and your family will spread like grass across the earth.

es.L: Y sabrás que tu descendencia [será] numerosa, \q y tus vástagos como la hierba de la tierra.
es.B: Sabrás que tu descendencia será numerosa, \q tus vástagos como la hierba de la tierra.
es.R: Verás que tendrás muchos hijos, \q y tu familia se extenderá como la hierba por la tierra.

fr.L: Et tu sauras que ta descendance [sera] nombreuse, \q et tes rejetons comme l’herbe de la terre.
fr.B: Tu sauras que ta descendance sera nombreuse, \q tes rejetons comme l’herbe de la terre.
fr.R: Tu verras que tu auras beaucoup d’enfants, \q et ta famille se répandra comme l’herbe sur la terre.

sw.L: Nawe utajua kwamba uzao wako [utakuwa] mwingi, \q na wazao wako kama majani ya nchi.
sw.B: Utajua kwamba uzao wako utakuwa mwingi, \q wazao wako kama nyasi za nchi.
sw.R: Utaona kwamba utakuwa na watoto wengi, \q na jamaa yako itaenea kama nyasi duniani.

vi.L: Và anh sẽ biết rằng dòng dõi anh [sẽ] đông đúc, \q và con cháu anh như cỏ của đất.
vi.B: Anh sẽ biết dòng dõi mình sẽ đông đúc, \q con cháu mình nhiều như cỏ trên mặt đất.
vi.R: Anh sẽ thấy mình có nhiều con cái, \q và gia đình anh sẽ lan rộng như cỏ khắp mặt đất.

ko.L: 그대는 그대의 씨가 많고 \q 그대의 후손이 땅의 풀과 같음을 알게 될 것이오.
ko.B: 그대는 자손이 많아지고 \q 후손이 땅의 풀처럼 번성하는 것을 알게 될 것이오.
ko.R: 그대는 자녀를 많이 얻고, \q 그대의 집안이 풀처럼 온 땅에 퍼지는 것을 보게 될 것이오.

decisions.choice: offspring, descendants: children and the family line after them
decisions.reason: Zera' (seed) and tse'etsa'im (what comes out) are a common pair for children and descendants (Isaiah 44:3; 48:19).

decisions.choice: a promise Job cannot hear without pain
decisions.reason: Job's sons and daughters have all died (1:18-19). Eliphaz's picture of the blessed man's many children falls hard on a man who has just buried his own.

decisions.choice: grass: green plants, a picture of abundance
decisions.reason: 'Esev is green growth, which springs up everywhere after rain (Psalm 72:16).

source.text: תָּב֣וֹא בְכֶ֣לַח אֱלֵי־קָ֑בֶר כַּעֲל֖וֹת גָּדִ֣ישׁ בְּעִתּֽוֹ׃

records.literal_gloss: You will come in full vigor to [the] grave, as goes up a stack of sheaves in its time.

en.L: You will come in full vigor to [the] grave, \q as a stack of sheaves goes up in its season.
en.B: You will come to your grave in full vigor, \q like sheaves gathered in at harvest time.
en.R: You will live to a ripe old age before you die, \q like grain brought in at the right time.

es.L: Llegarás con pleno vigor a [la] tumba, \q como se sube el montón de gavillas a su tiempo.
es.B: Llegarás a la tumba en pleno vigor, \q como las gavillas que se recogen en tiempo de cosecha.
es.R: Vivirás hasta una buena vejez antes de morir, \q como el trigo que se recoge a su debido tiempo.

fr.L: Tu viendras en pleine vigueur à [la] tombe, \q comme monte une meule de gerbes en son temps.
fr.B: Tu arriveras à la tombe en pleine vigueur, \q comme les gerbes rentrées au temps de la moisson.
fr.R: Tu vivras jusqu’à un bel âge avant de mourir, \q comme le blé qu’on rentre au bon moment.

sw.L: Utaingia kaburini ukiwa na nguvu kamili, \q kama rundo la miganda lipandishwavyo kwa wakati wake.
sw.B: Utafika kaburini ukiwa bado na nguvu, \q kama miganda ikusanywavyo wakati wa mavuno.
sw.R: Utaishi hadi uzee mwema kabla ya kufa, \q kama nafaka iletwayo ghalani kwa wakati wake.

vi.L: Anh sẽ vào mồ khi sức còn sung mãn, \q như đống bó lúa được đem lên đúng mùa.
vi.B: Anh sẽ về nơi mồ mả khi sức lực vẫn còn sung mãn, \q như những bó lúa được gom về lúc mùa gặt.
vi.R: Anh sẽ sống đến tuổi già trọn vẹn rồi mới qua đời, \q như lúa được thu về đúng lúc.

ko.L: 그대는 기력이 온전한 채 무덤에 이를 것이니, \q 곡식 단 더미가 제때에 올라가는 것과 같소.
ko.B: 그대는 기력이 충만한 채 무덤에 이를 것이니, \q 추수 때에 거두어들이는 곡식 단과 같을 것이오.
ko.R: 그대는 오래도록 잘 살다가 죽을 것이오. \q 곡식이 알맞은 때에 거두어지듯 말이오.

decisions.choice: full vigor: a ripe old age, strength not yet gone
decisions.reason: Kelach is a rare word, found only here and in 30:2. It seems to mean full strength or ripe maturity: you will die old but not broken.

decisions.choice: a stack of sheaves goes up: grain carried to the threshing floor
decisions.reason: At harvest the cut sheaves were stacked and carried up to the threshing floor. Grain is gathered when it is ripe, neither too early nor too late; so a good life ends at its proper time.

decisions.choice: live to a ripe old age before you die
alternatives: come in full vigor to the grave
decisions.reason: Readable says plainly what the picture means (m1, m2).

source.text: הִנֵּה־זֹ֭את חֲקַרְנ֥וּהָ כֶּֽן־הִ֑יא שְׁ֝מָעֶ֗נָּה וְאַתָּ֥ה דַֽע־לָֽךְ׃פ

records.literal_gloss: Look, this we have searched it out, so it [is]; hear it, and you, know [it] for yourself.

en.L: Look, this we have searched out; so it [is]. \q Hear it, and know [it] for yourself.
en.B: We have looked into all this, and it is true. \q So hear it and know it for your own good.
en.R: We have studied all this, and it is true. \q So listen, and accept it for your own good.

es.L: Mira, esto lo hemos investigado; así [es]. \q Escúchalo, y tú, sábelo para ti mismo.
es.B: Hemos examinado todo esto, y es verdad. \q Así que escúchalo y apréndelo para tu propio bien.
es.R: Hemos estudiado todo esto, y es verdad. \q Así que escucha, y acéptalo por tu propio bien.

fr.L: Voici, cela, nous l’avons sondé ; il en [est] ainsi. \q Écoute-le, et toi, sache-le pour toi-même.
fr.B: Nous avons examiné tout cela, et c’est vrai. \q Écoute-le donc et sache-le pour ton bien.
fr.R: Nous avons étudié tout cela, et c’est vrai. \q Alors écoute, et accepte-le pour ton bien.

sw.L: Tazama, hili tumelichunguza; ndivyo [lilivyo]. \q Lisikie, nawe ujue mwenyewe.
sw.B: Tumeyachunguza haya yote, nayo ni kweli. \q Basi yasikie na kuyajua kwa faida yako.
sw.R: Tumejifunza mambo haya yote, nayo ni kweli. \q Basi sikiliza, na uyakubali kwa faida yako mwenyewe.

vi.L: Kìa, điều này chúng tôi đã tra xét; [nó] là như vậy. \q Hãy nghe điều đó, và chính anh, hãy biết [nó] cho mình.
vi.B: Chúng tôi đã xem xét kỹ mọi điều này, và nó là thật. \q Vậy hãy nghe và ghi nhận cho lợi ích của anh.
vi.R: Chúng tôi đã tìm hiểu tất cả những điều này, và đúng là như vậy. \q Vậy anh hãy lắng nghe và chấp nhận để được ích lợi cho mình.

ko.L: 보시오, 이것은 우리가 살펴본 것이니, 그러하오. \q 들으시오, 그리고 그대 자신을 위해 알아 두시오.
ko.B: 우리가 이 모든 것을 살펴보았는데, 이것이 사실이오. \q 그러니 듣고 그대 자신을 위해 깨달으시오.
ko.R: 우리가 이 모든 것을 따져 보았는데, 다 사실이오. \q 그러니 잘 듣고 그대를 위해 받아들이시오.

decisions.choice: we: Eliphaz and the wise whose teaching he passes on
alternatives: Eliphaz and the other two friends
decisions.reason: Eliphaz speaks for the tradition of the wise, what has been searched out and tested over time (8:8-10; 15:9-10, 18).

decisions.choice: for yourself: for your own good
decisions.reason: "For you" after a command means "for your own sake" (Genesis 12:1). Eliphaz ends with confident advice: take this to heart, and it will go well with you.

decisions.choice: no "Look"
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable carry hinneh with the force of the sentence rather than a separate word. Literal keeps "Look".
